name: Hamilton (Bermuda)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with a gold ship under sail, between three white cinquefoils and a fourth below.
history: A banner of the city arms, whose ship and cinquefoils go with the motto 'Sparsa Collegit' (he gathered the scattered). The flag was reported in 2007; the date of the grant of arms and of the flag's adoption are not recorded.

features.symbolism: the vessel of Bermuda's founding governor
